description: This file provides wrapper functions around a configured-binding registry module, ensuring registration of built-in bindings before delegating the call to internal functions. It serves as an interface layer that enforces registration and calls underlying functions related to conversation bindings in a plugin system.

methods.name: export function primeConfiguredBindingRegistry( primeConfiguredBindingRegistry
methods.description: Wrapper function that registers built-in bindings and delegates to the underlying registry method.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBindingRecord( resolveConfiguredBindingRecord
methods.description: Wrapper function that ensures registration and resolves a binding record.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBindingRecordForConversation( resolveConfiguredBindingRecordForConversation
methods.description: Wrapper to resolve a binding record specific to a conversation context after ensuring registration.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBinding( resolveConfiguredBinding
methods.description: Wrapper to resolve a binding with registration check.

methods.name: export function resolveConfiguredBindingRecordBySessionKey( resolveConfiguredBindingRecordBySessionKey
methods.description: Wrapper to resolve a binding record by session key with registration check.
